name: Maha Anna (Maharashtra Ration / NFSA)
description: Maharashtra NFSA ration card and Public Distribution System for subsidised foodgrains.
benefits: Subsidised rice/wheat/cereals via Fair Price Shops; portability under One Nation One Ration Card.
eligibility: Maharashtra households meeting NFSA/state poverty criteria.
steps: Apply via MahaFood portal / rationing office.
faqs: What is Maha Anna (Maharashtra Ration / NFSA)?
